scenario: IRET.10.7 / LGRA.10.1.4: `withdraw j` in a call's `on response` body removes the Job the outer rule matched when the reply is processed, not when the call fires. The body logs "reply" and then withdraws `j`, and `gone` fires once no Job is left. So the log order is the observable: ["reply", "gone 1"]. A withdraw at fire time gives ["gone 1", "reply"], and a withdraw that misses the Job gives ["reply"]. PATH PINNED: the compiler captures `j` as a fact reference in the call's capture fact (`dsc.rete` `action_captures`) and lowers the nested withdraw to ACTION_WITHDRAW_BY_ID reading it (`dsc.encode`). libds's action loop resolves the reference with `ds_rete_wm_find_by_id` and retracts it as AUTHOR_WITHDRAWN (`rete/engine.c`).
rules_ds:
schema SvcReadReply scope ttl 1_h:
    corr: String
    ok: Bool

service svc.read:
    kwarg n: Int
    response SvcReadReply

schema Anchor scope explicit:
    v: Int

schema Job scope explicit:
    id: Int

rule r:
    Job j
->
    call svc.read n: j.id cooldown: 1_min as "c1"
        on response.ok == true:
            log info "reply"
            withdraw j

rule gone:
    Anchor a
    no Job
->
    log info "gone {a.v}"
